sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents illicit card transaction activity identified on customer account C13487 involving payment card C13487-K1. On 2016-11-22, transaction 3478561 totaling $74.96 was executed via the online channel. Investigation by automated graph intelligence matched the activity to pattern 'account_takeover' with a fraud confidence of 0.88. Connected entity analysis resolved device fingerprint 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M|Android 7.0|chrome 62.0 for android|1920x1080', which has been associated with multi-account transaction clusters across 52 customer profiles. The transaction volume significantly deviated from established baseline expenditure thresholds. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R6 and BSA/AML Suspicious Activity Reporting mandates, internal controls initiated card containment, and this matter is escalated for regulatory filing.
